title: 第1114 章 鸡老板第1113 章 奇怪的城
slug: 你一个武夫谁让你炼剑的
lines: 秦关站在城门口，又看了一会儿四周凝固的街景，然后迈步走了进去。
他沿着主街往里走，大概走了一炷香的时间，突然发现了一条长长的队伍。
队伍排得很长，从街角一直延伸到一座低矮的木屋门前，足足有数百人之多。
看到那群人，秦关神色顿时变得凝重起来，这几百人他居然一个都看不透，全都不是等闲之辈。
“没想到你来得这么快。”
就在秦关震惊之时，林岁岁突然出现他跟前。
“恩，来了。”
秦关点头，他看向远处那些排队排队的人好奇道：“岁岁，那些都是什么人啊？”
“他们都是在这里求道的人。”
林岁岁笑着说道。
“求道？”
秦关眉头一蹙：“那他们为何要在那里排队买炸鸡啊？”
“因为鸿蒙塔喜欢吃炸鸡，那些人排队买炸鸡是为了能进鸿蒙塔修炼。”
林岁岁说完拉着秦关的手：“哎呀别问了，咱们快去排队买炸鸡吧！”
秦关被林岁岁拉到了队伍最末端，开始排队。
秦关发现，前面那些买到炸鸡的人，拿到油纸包之后便迅速离开，脚步很快，头也不回。
没有人交谈，没有人回头张望，甚至连目光都很少交汇，整条队伍安静的不像是在排队，更像是在进行某种沉默的仪式，每个人都在无声地完成自己的那一份。
让秦关惊讶的是，一串炸鸡串居然需要一颗鸿蒙魂石，这炸鸡串绝对是他见过最贵的炸鸡。
“岁岁，他们手里的鸿蒙魂石好像和我打到的不太一样，怎么是纯紫色的？”
秦关收回目光看向林岁岁。
林岁岁笑道：“他们的鸿蒙魂石是纯的，你击杀妖兽得到的是被魔气污染过的。”
秦关听后微微点头：“那他们的鸿蒙魂石是从哪里得到的？”
“鸿蒙塔里有个赌场，可以在那里赢到。”
听到林岁岁的话，秦关突然哭笑不得。
又是炸鸡又是赌场，鸿蒙界这些修仙大佬都这么玩的吗？
“小子，你在和谁说话？”
就在这时，排在秦关的前面的一名中年男子忽然转头，神色古怪的看向秦关。
秦关先是一愣，随后挠了挠头笑道：“我看气氛有点安静，在自己和自己说话。”
“你有毛病吧，没事自己和自己说什么话？”
中年男子有些无语。
“你是新来吧？”
中年男子上下打量了下秦关：“不知道这里的规矩？”
“啥规矩啊，我是新来的。”
秦关点头好奇道。
content_en:
Qin Guan stood at the city gate, looked at the frozen street scene around him for a while, and then stepped in.
He walked along the main street, and after walking for about a stick of incense, he suddenly found a long queue.
The queue was very long, stretching from the street corner to the door of a low wooden house, with hundreds of people in it.
Seeing that group of people, Qin Guan's expression suddenly became serious. He could not see through any of these hundreds of people. They were not ordinary people.
"I didn't expect you to come so quickly."
Just when Qing Guan was shocked, Lin Suisui suddenly appeared in front of him.
"Well, here we come."
Qin Guan nodded. He looked at the people lining up in the distance and asked curiously: "Suisui, who are those people?"
"They are all here seeking enlightenment."
Lin Suisui said with a smile.
"Seeking enlightenment?"
Qin Guan frowned: "Then why are they queuing up there to buy fried chicken?"
"Because Hongmeng Tower likes to eat fried chicken, those people queue up to buy fried chicken so that they can enter Hongmeng Tower to practice."
After Lin Suisui finished speaking, he took Qinguan's hand: "Oh, don't ask, let's go queue up to buy fried chicken!"
Qin Guan was pulled to the end of the line by Lin Suisui and started to line up.
Qinguan found that those who bought fried chicken in front quickly left after getting the oil paper bags, walking very quickly without looking back.
No one talked, no one looked back, and even their eyes rarely met. The entire team was so quiet that it didn't look like they were queuing, but more like they were performing some kind of silent ritual. Everyone was completing their part silently.
What surprised Qinguan was that a skewer of fried chicken actually required a Hongmeng Soul Stone. This fried chicken skewer was definitely the most expensive fried chicken he had ever seen.
"Sui Sui, the Hongmeng Soul Stone in their hands seems to be different from the one I got. Why is it pure purple?"
Qinguan retracted his gaze and looked at Lin Suisui.
Lin Suisui smiled and said: "Their Hongmeng Soul Stone is pure. What you get by killing the monsters is contaminated by the demonic energy."
Qin Guan nodded slightly after hearing this: "Then where did they get the Hongmeng Soul Stone?"
"There is a casino in Hongmeng Tower where you can win."
Hearing Lin Suisui's words, Qin Guan suddenly couldn't laugh or cry.
It’s both fried chicken and a casino. Do these big immortal cultivators in Hongmeng Realm play this way?
"Boy, who are you talking to?"
At this moment, a middle-aged man in front of Qin Guan suddenly turned his head and looked at Qin Guan with a strange expression.
Qin Guan was stunned for a moment, then scratched his head and said with a smile: "I think the atmosphere is a bit quiet, I'm talking to myself."
"Is there something wrong with you? What should you say to yourself if you're fine?"
The middle-aged man was speechless.
Qinguan: "..."
"Are you new here?"
The middle-aged man looked Qinguan up and down: "Don't you know the rules here?"
"What are the rules? I'm new here."
Qin Guan nodded curiously.
